column1: # Phyre field offsets recovered from SCRIPT-ACCESSOR registrations, not from data-member
# A class that registers no DATA MEMBER reports nothing in phyre-field-schema.tsv. Many such
# classes register SCRIPT-CALLABLE ACCESSORS instead, and an adapter that is one instruction
# reading `this` carries the offset, the width and the machine type together - and says things
# a member record cannot: `movsd`/`movss` give double/float, `lea` rather than `mov` says the
# member is EMBEDDED, and a `btr`/`and`/`shr` after the load says the stored word is PACKED.
# THE CONTROL IS IN THE `status` COLUMN AND IT PASSES: of 89 reduced accessors, 47 AGREE with a
# row this store already derived from member metadata by a different route, 35 are NEW (no row,
# or an unobserved span), and 7 sit at a declared offset with a DIFFERENT width and are flagged
# rather than applied. An instrument that reproduces 47 known fields is reporting, not guessing.
# NOT IN THIS FILE: 131 further registrations whose adapter did not reduce to a single access.
# Those are candidates, not findings, and the generator deliberately refuses them - a getter
# that calls a helper or walks a chain is not a field.
